cases.name: player-first-launch
cases.expected: Role-safe onboarding reaches an authorized workspace and preserves Help access.

cases.name: gm-first-launch
cases.expected: GM sees only GM-authorized workspace guidance and explicit alpha boundaries.

cases.name: creator-first-launch
cases.expected: Creator teaching distinguishes authored drafts, governed sources and unresolved Pack-lifecycle gaps.

cases.name: campaign-join-safe
cases.expected: Teaching explains the joined Campaign and role without enumerating unavailable Campaigns or participants.

cases.name: character-creation-resume
cases.expected: Reload restores only the authorized draft and clearly distinguishes draft from authoritative state.

cases.name: library-inspector-help
cases.expected: Help shows authorized source/provenance fields and returns to the exact caller context.

cases.name: hidden-object-help-search
cases.expected: Unavailable hidden objects and topics do not leak through results, counts, ranking, autocomplete or empty-state wording.

cases.name: first-action-draft
cases.expected: Preview is explicitly nonauthoritative and no cost/effect is presented as committed.

cases.name: first-action-pending-gm
cases.expected: Player sees safe pending status without GM-only queue, warnings or adjudication data.

cases.name: gm-approval-teaching
cases.expected: GM guidance preserves original proposal evidence and explains approve, deny and modify-and-approve without committing before final confirmation.

cases.name: observer-safe-help
cases.expected: Observer teaching contains no control guidance or hidden Session state outside the observer projection.

cases.name: assistant-gm-delegation
cases.expected: Teaching is limited to active delegated scope and contracts after delegation expiry.

cases.name: owner-admin-no-blanket-access
cases.expected: Administrative teaching never implies blanket Player-private or Campaign-private content access.

cases.name: offline-read-only
cases.expected: Teaching identifies cached projection, expiry and permitted local draft actions while prohibiting authoritative offline mutation.

cases.name: ambiguous-submit
cases.expected: Guidance says status is unknown and routes to lookup/recovery with the original operation identity rather than resubmitting as new intent.

cases.name: reconnect-after-acceptance
cases.expected: Teaching distinguishes accepted durable Event from realtime delivery and displayed projection.

cases.name: revoked-during-help
cases.expected: Protected cached teaching derivatives invalidate and the safe return path does not reveal revoked content.

cases.name: permission-denial-inference-safe
cases.expected: Foundation specifies a safe state/next-action category but leaves final state-by-state wording to PPIA-14.

cases.name: entitlement-restricted-help
cases.expected: Only the approved restricted explanation is shown; protected catalog or mechanic details remain absent.

cases.name: pack-context-source-gap
cases.expected: Teaching may identify evidenced pack/version/lock context but cannot invent missing F024 lifecycle actions or UI.

cases.name: empty-state-after-filtering
cases.expected: Empty teaching is computed after authorization and cannot reveal that protected candidates exist.

cases.name: diagnostic-help-handoff
cases.expected: Only allowlisted/redacted safe diagnostics are explained; secrets, tokens and hidden payloads remain excluded.

cases.name: ai-help-zero-ai-parity
cases.expected: AI receives only filtered teaching projection and the same required guidance remains available without AI.

cases.name: mobile-single-focus
cases.expected: Single-focus layout preserves the same lesson evidence, warnings, choices, return path and completion semantics.

cases.name: keyboard-only-walkthrough
cases.expected: All walkthrough controls, dismiss/replay, Help and return actions are operable with visible semantic focus.

cases.name: screen-reader-nonvisual
cases.expected: Lesson ordering, current state, warning, required action and completion are conveyed semantically without visual inference.

cases.name: reduced-motion-high-zoom-noncolor
cases.expected: No lesson requires motion, color, hover or fixed-scale layout to understand progress or state.

cases.name: tutorial-campaign-player
cases.expected: Synthetic tutorial lesson demonstrates governed Player flow and remains explicitly noncanonical.

cases.name: tutorial-campaign-gm
cases.expected: Synthetic GM lesson demonstrates role-safe approval flow without becoming canonical Campaign content or producing hidden-information leaks.

cases.name: help-replay-no-duplicate-effects
cases.expected: Replaying teaching does not replay authoritative game mutations, duplicate accepted Effects or alter source state.
